scope: Code review of the current accurate-target prototype; numerical runs remain frozen.

findings.issue: The original categorical finite-table control used z=0, where its two sign families have equal likelihood. Its expected probabilities were uniform.
findings.change: The control now selects a fixed state with an analytically declared 1.2-log-unit contrast. This strengthens the control without changing sampler or flight code.
findings.verification: Passed the nonuniform five-entry conditional tables and both independent 4096-particle exact-Gaussian controls; source hashes recorded in nonuniform-mode-control/summary.json.

findings.issue: Ordinary independent guide proposals had no accepted whole-route jumps in the final population of the completed 128-particle one-direction timing pilot.
findings.consequence: Local movement and completion do not establish global route-family coverage. Independent runs, mode frequencies and independent flight recovery remain required.

findings.issue: The flight kernel uses a capped midpoint fixed-point iteration.
findings.consequence: The saved-flight refinement and limiting-case checks bound its numerical error on those tested paths; they are not proof over every possible flight state.

findings.issue: Every proposal currently invokes replay-flight-trajectory from the initial radar state, including proposals that change only late controls.
findings.consequence: Caching exact unchanged prefix states could reduce repeated work for flexible families, but has not been implemented or benchmarked. This would be an efficiency change, not evidence or a guarantee of mode mixing.

findings.issue: The kernel uses transition-sized steps whenever heading error exceeds the numerical tolerance, bank is nonzero, or Mach/altitude targets have not settled. Midpoint iteration repeatedly evaluates weather and heading guidance.
findings.consequence: Accurate propagation is intrinsically more expensive in this implementation. Existing replay benchmarks and per-run call counts document the cost; a fine-grained profiler is unavailable on this host. No speculative speedup is claimed.
